name: Long John Silver's

notes: Restaurant's own site (ljsilvers.com/menu) is a JS chain SPA whose national category pages show no prices; selected pickup near zip 92113 returned 'No Nearby Locations Available' for online ordering, so the own-ordering-platform tier was unreachable for this specific store. Fell back to this store's DoorDash storefront (confirmed same address via the 155 Marketplace Ave-specific store id 39705787 in the URL, and 'National City' listed first under Nearby Cities). name: La Imperial Taqueria
crossCheckedAgainst: taqueria-la-nueva-imperial.locallya.com (independent third-party directory, not affiliated with allmenus/Grubhub) agrees exactly on the Campechana Cali/California Burrito price of $7.49
notes: IMPORTANT: the work item's website field, taquerialanuevaimperial.shop, is NOT a real restaurant site - it 301-redirects to a generic third-party directory listing (locallya.com), one of several near-identical templated mirror pages for this restaurant (foodplacee.com, bestcafes.online were also found), matching the fabricated/templated .shop-network pattern from prior findings. Left that domain without treating it as first-party. The restaurant genuinely exists at 1351 3rd Ave, Chula Vista (confirmed via Yelp 'Taqueria Imperial', 244 reviews, and Uber Eats, both at the same address) but no own-site or own-ordering-platform could be found; Uber Eats 403'd on fetch. Used allmenus (tier 5) as the primary source, cross-checked against the locallya directory listing which independently agrees on the Campechana Cali Burrito price ($7.49 on both). Cheap, odd-cent pricing throughout (fish taco $1.50, lengua taco $3.00) is consistent with real till prices rather than platform markup. Reached: Breakfast Burritos, Burritos, Tacos, Mulitas, Tortas, Carne Asada Fries, Rolled Tacos, Combo Plates, Beverages.
